title: 1959 3c Progress of Women Used Stamp on Envelope
descriptionText: The product is a United States postage stamp featuring the "Progress of Women" design, specifically from the 1941-1950 era. The stamp has been used and is on an envelope, as depicted in the pictures provided. It is a collectible item that showcases a piece of history from the United States related to women's rights and progress. Stamp collectors and enthusiasts may find this item to be a unique and valuable addition to their collection.
